answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning is in its fastest growth period and will probably double in size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the US. The period ('over the coming years') and the size measure (headcount, revenue or capacity) are unstated, so it cannot be mapped to any question. The Corning-NVIDIA item (three optical facilities in North Carolina and Texas, more than 3,000 jobs, tenfold US optical capacity expansion, no completion date) is a sizeable but undated and unsourced relay of a partnership NVIDIA has not itself confirmed in this record.
